text:
Lena R.: SummitCo just confirmed they want a 10-day shared sandbox to validate embeddings + low-latency chat for a channel demo. They asked for EU data residency, SCIM user provisioning, and an option to bring their HSM. Can infra confirm feasibility and rough timeline?
Omar (Solutions): EU region + SCIM ok. HSM bring-your-own will need Private or Dedicated profile; hosted can proxy keys but not direct HSM. What are their latency targets?
Jay - SummitCo: Target: p95 < 300ms for chat, p99 < 600ms. We'll do synthetic load spikes to 800 QPS first week. We also want per-tenant billing exports and a daily usage CSV.
Lena R.: Noted. Proposed pilot bundle: isolated sandbox tenant in eu-central-1, SCIM + SAML, 50k dev tokens, ability to request a 72h burst at 2x capacity, and telemetry webhook for usage. Does that sound feasible?
infra-bot: sandbox-summit-1765554321 provisioning started by infra-queue.
Omar (Solutions): Feasible with caveats: 1) Burst requires pre-approved quota and can impact other tenants if on shared pool; recommend dedicated burst nodes for the demo window. 2) KMS via proxy supported; direct HSM requires Private deployment + legal DPA addendum. 3) We'll need IP ranges for allowlist and mTLS cert for ingestion.
Jay - SummitCo: We can provide IP ranges and certs. For the HSM, we prefer staging proxy first and iterate. Is there an ops on-call for the load window?
Maya (Legal): If SummitCo insists on HSM for keys-in-use later, legal will need to route a DPA and addendum. That adds ~2-3 week review. For the pilot we should keep hosted with proxy.
Lena R.: OK — plan: start with hosted+proxy. If metrics justify, discuss Private timeline. Omar, can you draft a minimal runbook and a short architecture diagram for their security team?
Omar (Solutions): Will do. Runbook items: load window, expected QPS, fallback model, circuit breaker thresholds, telemetry endpoint, contact rotation. Example routing snippet: \n```\nservice_routing:\n  primary: eu-central-1\n  failover: eu-west-1\n  model_variant: redwood-q8-4x\n  burst_policy: {enabled: true, multiplier: 2.0}\n  slo_99_ms: 600\n```\ninfra-bot: sandbox-summit-1765554321 ready 12: staging URL: https://staging.redwood.example/tenants/summit-demo
Jay - SummitCo: Great. I'll start SCIM config and SAML metadata exchange tomorrow. Also confirm: can we get daily usage CSV to s3?
Lena R.: Yes, we can drop CSVs to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket (or give API access). Which do you prefer?
Jay - SummitCo: S3 drop with mTLS is preferred. We'll supply bucket details and IAM role.
Maya (Legal): Also checklist for security questionnaire: SOC2 scope, data retention policy, deletion flow, encryption keys, access logs, subprocessor list. SummitCo please point to your compliance contact so we can exchange docs.
Jay - SummitCo: Compliance contact: lena.security@summitco.io and sec-ops@summitco.io. We'll share their questionnaire responses by EOD Fri.
Omar (Solutions): A couple of engineering notes: prefix caching isolation must be validated for shared sandbox to avoid cross-tenant leakage. We'll run a cache-isolation test during smoke. Also ensure embeddings storage is tagged per-tenant for deletion.
Lena R.: Good call. Can infra schedule a cache-isolation smoke test?
infra-bot: cache-isolation-test queued. ETA: 2h.
infra-bot: cache-isolation-test: pass 12 no cross-tenant keys observed.
Omar (Solutions): Nice. One potential enterprise blocker: if SummitCo requires private peering for S3 ingestion and HSM, we need network engineering time. That would push full HSM timeline +3 weeks. Recommend staging without peering initially.
Jay - SummitCo: Understood. We'll proceed with staging proxy and S3 drop. Can we get a temporary pilot pricing: trial credits + a 20% pilot discount?
Lena R.: Sales has okayed 20% off hosted rates for the pilot + 75k trial tokens. Omar, any cost caveats if they hit burst?
Omar (Solutions): Burst will be metered at a higher rate if we spin dedicated nodes; we'll reflect that in the term sheet. Also callout: EU region model variants may be limited; if a quantized variant isn't available, latency could increase.
Lena R.: Action items: 1) Omar to attach runbook + arch diagram (due Tue) 2) Infra to validate mTLS endpoint and S3 drop (done/ongoing) 3) Legal to prep DPA note for HSM path (Maya) 4) Sales to send draft term sheet to SummitCo (Lena)
Jay - SummitCo: We'll complete SAML metadata upload tonight and start SCIM mappings tomorrow morning. Looking forward to Thu 11am CET tech sync.
infra-bot: smoke-run: baseline p95=210ms p99=480ms (small sample, eu-central-1).
Maya (Legal): Noted on DPA timing. If SummitCo confirms HSM later, we will queue the addendum but don't let it block the pilot.
Lena R.: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as canonical for async updates. Please post any infra errors here and cc the new private channel #pilot-summitco if needed. :white_check_mark:
